# jans_script_by_name (Data Source)

Data source for looking up a custom script by its name (GET /config/scripts/name/{name}).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the script to look up.

### Read-Only

- `aliases` (List of String) Aliases of the script.
- `description` (String) Description of the script.
- `dn` (String) Distinguished name of the script.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the script is enabled.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inum` (String) XRI i-number, used as the unique identifier of the script.
- `level` (Number) Level of the script.
- `location_path` (String) Path to the script when stored on the file system.
- `location_type` (String) Where the script is stored (e.g. db, file).
- `programming_language` (String) Programming language the script is written in.
- `revision` (Number) Revision of the script.
- `script` (String) The actual script source.
- `script_type` (String) The type of the script.
